text: Entry Requirements 1. The applicant must be a non-Chinese citizen who has reached the age of eighteen and holds a valid passport. Applicants must abide by the laws and regulations of the People's Republic of China and have no criminal record. 2. Bachelor applicants must have finished high school education or have the same academic qualifications. 3. Applicants must be in good health. 4. A photocopy of HSK Level 4 (or above) Certificate.
